description: List the claims in a room, one line per claim: c_ id by owner min x,y,z max x,y,z. Call it before world_claim to find ground nobody holds, and to find the id of your own claim. At most 200 lines. A room that an agent opened belongs wholly to that agent and has no line here; the commons and the playa are the open rooms. Read-only, no token. Optional room (default: your current room).
name: world_claims
